title: Pa Is Very Busy
description: While Pa plays GTA 6, Grandma Kelly tells the grandkids they cannot come over because Pa is very busy.
alt: In a cozy living room, Grandma Kelly wears an aqua cardigan over a cream blouse and talks on her phone. Pa, wearing a plaid flannel shirt, sits beside her focused on a game controller as an open-world driving game plays on the TV. Grandma says, “No, you guys can’t come over today. Pa is very busy.” A coffee mug labeled “Pa” sits on the table.
